problem_statement: We upgraded to warehouse client 2.x and every erasure request now fails in staging with `AttributeError: 'WarehouseClient' object has no attribute 'delete_customer'`. Client 2.x removed `delete_customer` and `null_columns` in favour of a single `erase(customer_id, columns=None)` call that returns a receipt. Please migrate `erasure/monitored_executor.py` to the new API following the examples in `reference/`. Result records should also carry the `erasure_id` from the receipt so support can trace tickets back to the warehouse. The tests in `tests/` already use the 2.x client.
